'''Miki''' (Japanese: '''ミキ''' ''Miki'') is a [[character of the day]] who appeared in ''[[EP152|Hot Matches!]]''.

Miki had been {{pkmn|training}} her {{p|Skarmory}} in the mountains between [[Azalea Town]] and [[Goldenrod City]] for several weeks prior to meeting {{Ash}} and {{ashfr}}. She defeated many {{pkmn|Trainer}}s but was very eager to battle {{type|Fire}} Pokémon in the hopes of teaching her Skarmory how to overcome its [[type]] disadvantage. {{an|Brock}} found Miki to be very pretty, but Miki mistook him for a Trainer and challenged him, telling him to use a Fire type. Skarmory successfully defeated [[Brock's Vulpix]] and was on the verge of defeating [[Ash's Cyndaquil]] before the battle was interrupted by Team Rocket. However, Ash believed that Cyndaquil could become stronger than Skarmory if it could light its flame when needed. Over dinner, Miki revealed that she follows an intense training schedule; Ash went on to adapt it to help his Cyndaquil become stronger and finally control its flame.

Miki decided to have a [[rematch]] against Ash to see how well his training had progressed, and Cyndaquil proved to be powerful enough to defeat Skarmory. Miki complimented Ash on his training, and she was inspired to embark on her own {{pkmn|journey}} and take on the [[Johto League]] [[Gym Leader]]s.
